title: refactor: simplify auto top-up eligibility
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Inline the three eligibility checks where they are used
- Remove the one-use eligibility union and helper
- Preserve the same skip reasons and pack validation

Checks:
- `npm run typecheck`
- `npx vitest run test/integration/stripe.test.ts` (70 tests)

gist.headline: Top-ups, less ceremony
gist.blurb: The auto top-up path shed a small amount of paperwork without changing its judgment. Same guardrails, fewer places for them to hide.
gist.summary: Refactored auto top-up eligibility by inlining its three existing checks and removing a one-use union/helper while preserving skip reasons and pack validation.
gist.impact: Auto top-up behavior remains the same, with the eligibility logic now easier for maintainers to trace and update.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a meticulous beekeeper at a cozy billing garden, replacing a tangled three-branch paper checklist with three clear signposts leading to a validated Pollen jar. A small CRT monitor robot can inspect the checklist, while code-plants and flowers show that the rules remain intact despite the tidier path.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and a tiny accountant visor, tidying three paper eligibility checklists into three clear garden signposts beside a glowing validated Pollen jar; a friendly CRT monitor robot watches from a retro terminal among code-plants and flowers. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic but beautiful.
